P L U G I N D E V E L O P E R · F O R E S T E R

Data is my third plugin for GeoLibre. It grew out of a question I ask almost every week as a forester: which species have been recorded here? I wanted that answer inside my own map, next to my own boundaries and field data, without writing a script every time.

Much of what I know about where species live comes from people I will never meet: herbarium curators, museum staff, field surveyors, citizen scientists, and the institutions that publish their records. Thank you to
, its participant countries and nodes, and every data publisher and observer behind each point on the map. You made that knowledge open, consistent and free to reach.

My sincere thanks to Dr. Qiusheng Wu and the GeoLibre project for an open platform and a plugin registry that welcomes independent contributors, and to everyone in the GeoLibre community who tried the plugin and gave feedback.
I built the plugin to follow
’s rules, to credit the people who did the work, and to make citing their data the easy path rather than the forgotten one. I hope this guide does the same for you.
